---
title: "Workspace Tracker `r Sys.Date()`"
data: "`r Sys.Date()`"
output: flexdashboard::flex_dashboard
---

```{r, results='asis', echo=FALSE}
html_files <- list.files(path = "Reports", full.names = FALSE)

# 3. Check if files exist, then loop and generate relative paths
if (length(html_files) > 0) {
  for (file in html_files) {
    # Create the relative URL path (e.g., Reports/report1.html)
    relative_path <- file.path("Reports", file)
    
    # Create a clean display name (e.g., "Report1" instead of "report1.html")
    display_name <- gsub(".html", "", file)
    display_name <- gsub("_", " ", display_name) # Replaces underscores with spaces for readability
    
    # Output the Markdown link
    cat(sprintf("[%s](%s)\n", display_name, relative_path))
  }
} else {
  cat("_No reports found in the subdirectory._\n")
}
```
